title: The Empty Shelf
story: The gate guard of Ledgerhold hands you a lantern and a task. The Records Hall looks empty on paper, but the clerks swear the books are still in the scrolls table. Show them everything that is stored.

title: The Wanted Poster
story: A poster is needed for a thief, and it must show only a name and the last place seen. Pick just those columns and give them neat titles.

title: The Suspicious Ledger
concept: WHERE with AND, OR, and NOT
story: The ledger lists thousands of coin payments. Find the payments above 500 coins that were made in the market district.

title: The Guild List
story: The guild master wants the five oldest members, and a list of every guild name with no repeats.

title: The Plague Count
concept: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, and MAX
story: The healers need numbers: how many records were damaged, and what the average damage is per shelf.

title: Guild by Guild
story: Count the damaged records for each guild, and show only the guilds with more than ten.

title: Smudge, the Ink Beast
story: Smudge floods the hall with ink and blurs every record. Answer its questions before the ink dries.

title: The Ghost Entries
story: Some entries have no author, and others have names that begin with a strange mark. Find the ghosts.

title: The Returning Clerk
story: A clerk returns from exile. Add her to the registry with the correct details.

title: The Cleanup
story: Fix the misspelled guild names and remove the duplicate entries without deleting the real ones.

title: Two Ledgers, One Truth
story: The city keeps payments in one table and people in another. Join them to see who paid what.

title: The Biggest Debtor
story: Find everyone who owes more than the average debtor, using a query inside a query.

title: The Final Audit
story: Rank the guilds by damage and show a running total, so the council can see how the Plague spread.

title: Archivist Null
concept: Review of the whole SQL world
story: Archivist Null is the heart of the Plague. It asks everything you have learned about reading, changing, and connecting records.
